Definition: of Hebrew origin (probably for H454); Esli, an Israelite:--Esli.
BiblicalUsage: Eslí is the name of a man in the genealogy of Jesus, between Naum and Nagge. He appears once, in Luke's genealogy, and nothing more is told of him. The name is carried forward by the genealogy alone.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Eslí as it stands — a name in the line of Christ — and I am glad the genealogy kept him.
